title: Spicy Ethiopian-Style Kielbasa Fry-Up
description: A bold and spicy twist on traditional kielbasa, seasoned with Ethiopian spices and served with a side of crispy fried onions.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced onions and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add sliced kielbasa and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add berbere spice blend, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add beef broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 5 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. If desired, add hot sauce for an extra kick.
Serve hot, garnished with additional sliced onions and a dollop of hot sauce if desired.
